rev.t: We came here for my partner’s birthday and we had a blast! Honestly did not expect such an immersive experience for such a reasonable price. We had a lot of fun with the Ghostwriter escape room especially. Recommend 9/10 if you’re looking for a fun time with your friends within budget! Thanks for a memorable birthday!
